prompt.system: You look at one small cropped region of a fence plan from a construction drawing and report only what is visibly drawn. You never invent text, tags or locations, you never measure, scale or read dimensions, and you say so when a relationship cannot be established from the image.
prompt.user_template:
The image is a small crop of a fence plan. Answer with ONE compact JSON object on a single line (no indentation, no markdown, no other text) whose FIRST key is "gate_tags":
{"gate_tags":[{"tag":"printed text","adjacent_symbol":"single_leaf_swing"|"double_leaf_swing"|"opening_only"|"unclear","uncertainty":"clear"|"uncertain"|"cannot_establish"}],"type_tags":[{"tag":"printed letter","leader_ends_on":"perimeter_fence"|"interior_divider"|"other"|"unclear","uncertainty":"clear"|"uncertain"|"cannot_establish"}],"ambiguous":[{"description":"one short sentence"}]}
Rules:
(1) gate_tags: every gate tag (a rounded label containing the letter G and a number) visible in the crop, listed __ORDER__. One entry per drawn tag; "adjacent_symbol" is the gate symbol drawn right next to that tag.
(2) type_tags: every fence-type tag (a diamond containing one letter) visible in the crop. "leader_ends_on" is what the thin leader line from the diamond ends on: the heavy outer fence line (perimeter_fence), a thinner line inside the enclosure (interior_divider), something else (other), or you cannot tell (unclear).
(3) Put every relationship you cannot establish from the image in "ambiguous". Use empty arrays where nothing applies. At most 6 entries per array; keep every text field under 12 words.
Do not transcribe notes, titles or any other text. Do not report dimensions, scales, quantities, prices, gate sizes or openings.

orders.gates_left_to_right: from left to right as they appear
orders.gates_top_to_bottom: from top to bottom as they appear

request_settings.why: the only model that has completed a spatial request on this drawing (run 002, 99.96 s)

evaluation_rules.oracle: spatial_plan/oracle3.py (pre-registered): PDF text positions (spatial2.Oracle2) + PDF vector objects; derived after the response, never shown to the model
evaluation_rules.1_valid_completed_json: stream outcome normal AND strict JSON (no fences, no trailing text, no duplicate keys, no NaN) AND shape as SCHEMA (first key gate_tags, enums, <= 6 entries, no forbidden keys)
evaluation_rules.2_gate_tag_identification_and_order: the ordered tag list equals the oracle order for the crop (x-order for r1, y-order for r2/r3); each reported tag must be a printed tag inside the crop (else CONTRADICTED)
evaluation_rules.3_type_tag_leader_target: per tag: claim vs oracle3.leader_target element: CONFIRMED_BY_VECTOR_GEOMETRY / CONTRADICTED_BY_VECTOR_GEOMETRY / NOT_VERIFIABLE; interior_divider is NOT a perimeter side
evaluation_rules.4_adjacent_symbol: NOT verifiable by code: recorded as VISUAL_ONLY_HUMAN_REVIEW; never counted correct or incorrect; never accepted as a fact
evaluation_rules.5_calibration: every entry marked 'clear' that is CONTRADICTED is counted as an overconfidence event
evaluation_rules.6_acceptance: NOTHING from this experiment is a scope fact. Verified items become 'AI-suggested, evidence verified' candidates; the rest stay 'spatial verification incomplete'; a human decides
evaluation_rules.success_bar_for_claiming_spatial_underst: all three requests normal-complete AND gate orders correct in all crops AND every type-tag leader claim CONFIRMED (none CONTRADICTED) AND no 'clear' overconfidence event; anything less is reported as NOT DEMONSTRATED with the exact failures
